name: ChatGPT Business (Standard seat)

price.note: Per seat, billed monthly. $20 per seat per month billed annually.

check.label: Codex usage page, or /status in the CLI

reset.rule: A 5-hour window. The usage API and Settings → Usage show the exact reset time.
stipulations: Codex and ChatGPT Work share this allowance.
Local messages and cloud tasks share it. A cloud task may use more than a local message.
Bigger tasks and stronger models use more. OpenAI publishes ranges per model, not fixed counts.
Fast mode spends it at 2x on GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol, and at 2.5x on other models.
GitHub code reviews (@codex on a PR, or automatic reviews) are metered as Code Review usage. Local /review runs count here like any other task.

meters.label: Codex + Work weekly
meters.hint: Applies on top of the 5-hour window

reset.rule: A 7-day window. The usage API and Settings → Usage show the exact reset time.
stipulations: Everything that counts toward the 5-hour window also counts here.
OpenAI doesn't publish the weekly size.
Workspaces created 23 to 30 Nov 2026 get double the weekly allowance through 31 Dec 2026.

resets.label: Banked Codex resets

count.rule: Given out in OpenAI promotions, including some referral offers. The usage API reports how many you hold and how many you can use right now.

resets.howTo: Desktop app: Settings → Usage & billing, select the reset and confirm. CLI: /usage, then Redeem reset.
stipulations: Free. Each reset has its own expiry date, shown in your account or the offer.
On Business Standard it restores the 5-hour and weekly allowances to 100%.
You can only use one when the 5-hour or weekly allowance has less than 80% left.
Unused or expired resets aren't refunded or replaced.

overage: At a limit, usage can continue on workspace credits if an admin has bought them. Credit purchases are optional. Paid instant resets aren't available on Business.

how: Codex has a 5-hour window and a weekly window, the same per-model ranges as Plus.
Includes ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex, with cloud tasks on larger VMs.
15 Pro messages per month, shared between GPT-6 Pro and GPT-5.6 Sol Pro.
Up to $500 per month in API credits for the workspace. Unused credits expire at the end of the billing cycle.
ext: The Codex extension works in most VS Code forks, including Cursor.
quirks: OpenAI doesn't train on workspace data.
The pricing page says Business starts at 2 users. The Business FAQ says you can start with 1 paid seat.
Workspaces created before 24 Jun 2026 may still have legacy Codex-only seats, which run on workspace credits from the first request.
The Codex usage API reports "team" or "self_serve_business_usage_based" for this seat. "business" means Enterprise there.

modelTable.title: Codex on Business Standard: local messages per 5 hours
modelTable.note: OpenAI's estimates at Standard speed, the same as Plus. Big tasks land at the low end.
modelTable.footer: A weekly limit applies on top. OpenAI doesn't publish its size.

events.what: Last day to create a Business workspace and get 2x weekly Work and Codex usage plus Fast mode at no extra cost for all seats. Existing and reactivated workspaces don't qualify.
Starting in December, ChatGPT and Codex share one token-based allowance on Plus, Pro and Business. Instant chat won't count. OpenAI gives no exact date and some accounts may switch earlier.
The new-workspace 2x weekly usage and free Fast mode promo ends.
